CustomField.label: Run Mode
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines whether PrivacyGuard masks all eligible records, changed records only, or records only once.
CustomField.description: Full (mask every record every run, default), Delta (mask only records created/modified since they were last masked - requires a DateTime Delta_Tracking_Field__c and can detect a record being re-populated with real data after masking), or Once (mask each record a single time ever - requires a Checkbox Delta_Tracking_Field__c, simpler than Delta but cannot detect a record being re-populated with real data after masking, since a boolean carries no timing information).
